newsitem.title: USA: InVision gets contracts totalling $6.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: InVision gets contracts totalling $6.2 mln.

text.p: InVision Technologies Inc said Thursday it had received contracts totalling $6.2 million for its explosives detection systems.
Four CTX 5000 systems have been ordered by the Hong Kong Airport Authority for use at the new airport at Chek Lap Kok, InVision said.
One system has been ordered by Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.

The system is scheduled for shipment to Amsterdam by the end of the month. The new Hong Kong airport is scheduled to open in April 1998, and the four InVision units are scheduled to be operational at that time.
InVision says its CTX 5000 system detects all classes and quantities of explosives determined by the Federal Aviation Administration to be a threat to civil aviation.
